title: trailboss --json until ls (and until pause, resume, stop, and until --detach)
description: The `until` loops running on this machine, one object each; `until pause|resume|stop` print the loops they asked, and `until --detach` the loop it started (an empty array when that loop already ended on a pass), in the same shape. A loop whose process has ended is dropped. Nothing from the check's output or the session's transcript is in it.

id.description: The loop's id (its process id): what `until pause|resume|stop` take, besides the session.

agent.description: The agent the loop drives (claude, codex, …).

session.description: Its session id; null for an agent without one.

cwd.description: The folder the check runs in.

check.description: The check as given, its words joined by spaces.

state.description: running, checking (the check is running now; `until stop` kills it), paused (`until pause`), waiting (for a quota or rate-limit reset) or stopped (its last moment).

requested.description: pause or stop when asked and not yet taken up (the loop reads it at its next look); null when nothing is asked.

last_passed.description: Whether the last check passed; null before the first.

cost_usd.description: Dollars the session has spent since the loop started.

minutes.description: Minutes the loop has run, not counting pauses and resets.

paused_until.description: While waiting: until when (seconds since the epoch).

log.description: A detached loop's log (`until --detach`): the file its lines go to, beside the index. null for a loop running in a terminal.
